title: boardui component model mapping
description: Maps components to body models: for the converter (boardui convert --models, spec §6.9) and for the viewer at runtime (mappingSource of @boardui/models, spec §6.15). Model conventions: Y-up, metres, origin at the package origin, top-side placement at 0° rotation, seating plane at y = 0 (STEP models are read as Z-up millimetres and converted). Rules that match more than the package (part, refDes, attributes) are tried first, then rules that match the package only, each in file order; the first match wins. The converter applies rules that match exactly one part or package by name to a local glTF/GLB file, and skips the others (wildcards, refDes and attribute matches, URLs, templates, STEP and OBJ models) with a warning.

match.description: What the rule matches; every given field must match. `*` stands for any text and `?` for one character (viewer only).

attributes.description: BOM attributes of the component (spec §8.4), e.g. {"MPN": "GRM155*"}. Viewer only.

file.description: Path of the model, relative to the mapping file. The viewer also takes an absolute URL and placeholders, filled in URL-encoded: {part}, {package}, {refDes}, {side}, {mount} and attribute names such as {MPN}; a rule whose placeholder has no value doesn't match.

format.description: The model's format; default from the file extension (.glb, .gltf, .step/.stp, .obj; the converter reads any other as glTF). The converter reads glb and gltf only.

offsetMm.description: Translation applied in the model's frame, in millimetres.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation about the model's X, then Y, then Z axis (fixed axes), applied in the model's frame before placement, in degrees. The child node's transform is scale, then this rotation, then offsetMm.

scale.description: Uniform scale, e.g. 0.001 for a model authored in millimetres.
